what_this_is: The element list and the measured model answers for the one notice that forced the mfr redesign. Transcribed VERBATIM from the raw BAML I/O captured out of the sandbox pod and recorded in sessions/2026-09-29-eol36-raw-baml-io.md. 'elements' is the document text exactly as the rendered prompt carried it: one entry per unstructured element, its type and its text. 'model_answers' is what ExtractHeader returned for mfr over six fires on byte-identical input (rendered-prompt sha256 e1adfbbd..., 1713 input tokens).
caveats: Three ttelectronics.com e-mail addresses inside the page-2 Sales Contacts table are replaced by '[e-mail redacted]'. They are real people's addresses. The substitution cannot affect any measurement here: Table elements are never candidates for a document-read name.

No coordinates. The rendered prompt carries type and text only. Bboxes are synthesised by the test helper because nothing in the mfr path reads them; a test that needs real geometry must not use this fixture.
